title: One construction for quark and lepton mass ratios and mixing
description:
Read the full paper (PDF)

One exact overlap construction generates both complete quark and lepton alignment matrices, while the Fold mass-ratio identity holds at every positive depth.

Maria Smith derives all matrix cells, their generating locks, mirror closure for every symmetric observable, common two-operation generation return, exact quark cubics and lightest-carrier confinement.

The completed CKM graph passes all four registered uncertainty comparisons. Its half-One CP-square transport predicts a baryon-to-photon ratio near 6.14612312138 × 10⁻¹⁰. Complete colour-composite dressing predicts a proton/electron ratio near 1836.152673425313, with the full exact enclosure inside the registered CODATA standard uncertainty.

The paper includes intermediate mathematics, exact root-refinement methods, every original comparison row, complete candidate grammars, native Lean proof references and the original observational-derivation protocol. The archive provides pinned V3/V4 sources, full-program and empirical comparisons, build and zero-axiom audit evidence, and portable exact-arithmetic reproduction.
